info.title: Digital Shop API
info.description: Generated from the live Express routes, so every path listed exists in code. Request and response bodies are generic objects unless an endpoint has a detailed schema. Authenticated routes expect `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from POST /api/auth/login. Role rules: owner routes need an owner or staff user (some actions are owner-only), admin routes need superadmin. Responses use `{ "error": "message" }` on failure.

get.description: Superadmin master switches for owner dashboard features, enforced server-side.
Clients: trial, plan, store limit and manual monthly payment tracking (no gateway).

post.description: Only the authenticated superadmin can create an owner account and its first store.

get.description: Superadmin: status never returns the URL (only its hash is stored). Generating returns it once.

post.description: Public registration is intentionally disabled. Existing clients cannot create accounts.

get.description: Kitchen / staff: mark dishes sold out for today without needing product-edit rights.

post.description: Staff-created order (phone / walk-in / no QR). Lands in Kitchen exactly like a customer order (status new, same table/channel rules).
Staff adds more items to an open (unbilled) order; the Kitchen sees the new lines on the same order.

patch.summary: Edit items on a New restaurant order (lower or remove only)
patch.description: Only allowed while the order status is New. Quantities can only go down or lines be removed. Delivery fee never increases; an edit that would put the items subtotal below the saved discount is refused with 409. Send dryRun: true to preview totals without saving.

409.description: Order is locked, or the edit would drop below the saved discount

get.description: Waiter / bill requests raised from a table QR. Staff with order access can see and clear them.

post.description: Nearby shops directory. POST so the visitor's coordinates never appear in a URL or access log, and they are never stored.
